A flowchart showing the Structural Adjustment Programme (SAP). Top box: "Economic Crisis (Falling oil prices, debt)". Arrow down to middle box: "Introduction of SAP (1986)". Three arrows branch out to three lower boxes: 1. "Devaluation of Naira (SFEM)", 2. "Privatization of public enterprises", 3. "Removal of subsidies". Further arrows point from these to a bottom row showing outcomes: "Growth of banking sector", "Increase in non-oil exports", and "High inflation & SAP Riots (1989)".
